max_tire.note: On stock wheels or the same offset. One owner runs them at stock height with a slight torsion-bar crank and doesn't rub at full stuff, apart from a scrub on the sway bar at full lock (stock 35s do the same). 37x14.50s didn't fit.

One owner runs 38s with no lift and a leveling kit; another used GM's 'green' torsion keys to gain about 2 in up front for 38s. Owners warn cranked torsion bars ride harder and wear the steering linkage faster.
Owners report 37s on a 4-in Rancho lift with a 1-in body lift, and 38-in Mickey Thompson Baja MTZs on a 4-in Rancho.
Fabtech 6-in lifts on 40s are common. Owners recommend wheels with 4.5-in backspacing. The lift drops the torsion bars and crossmember lower under the truck.

items.title: Windshield wiper motor failure
items.summary: Improperly manufactured wiper motors could fail, reducing visibility in bad weather.

items.title: Ignition key / shift lever override
items.summary: Mechanical overrides let the key come out or the shifter leave Park in ways FMVSS 114 doesn't allow without a locking column.

items.title: Hydro-boost relief valve bore
items.summary: An out-of-spec relief valve bore in the Hydro-boost brake housing could fracture its O-ring seal, slightly increasing steering and brake effort.

items.title: Hydro-boost accumulator cracking
items.summary: The Bosch Hydro-boost pressure accumulator could crack and separate; fragments could injure people near the engine bay with the hood open.

items.title: Second-row center seat belt routing
items.summary: The center rear lap belt may not sit low across the hips; owner's manual guidance was updated.

items.title: Power steering hose
items.summary: An out-of-spec hose could fracture at full lock while braking, losing power steering and, with Hydro-boost, power brake assist.

items.title: Tire and loading label
items.summary: Labels listed an incorrect vehicle capacity weight (FMVSS 110).

items.title: ABS wheel-speed sensor wiring
items.summary: The front or rear ABS sensor harness wires may be reversed, which can lengthen stopping distances.

items.title: Heated washer fluid module (first campaign)
items.summary: A short on the washer-heater circuit board could overheat its ground wire; the fix added a fuse.

items.title: Water in the wiper motor module
items.summary: On 13,358 model-year 2003 H2s, water could get into the wiper motor module and make the wipers intermittent or stop them working.

items.title: Heated washer fluid module (second campaign)
items.summary: New thermal incidents after the 2008 fix; the heated washer module could melt or catch fire.

items.title: Fabtech aftermarket pitman arms
items.summary: An equipment recall for Fabtech pitman arms FTS71000 and FTS71001: the internal pin can shear and cause total loss of steering. Check any lifted truck that has them.

timeline.change: In December, GM buys the Hummer name from AM General; AM General keeps building the trucks
GM shows the H2 concept, which has independent rear suspension that the production truck drops
The H2 SUT pickup concept, with an Avalanche-style Midgate, is shown at the New York auto show

The production H2 goes on sale in 2002 as a 2003 model, built by AM General in Mishawaka: 6.0 L LQ4 V8, 4L65-E four-speed, BorgWarner 44-84 full-time transfer case, standard Eaton rear ELocker, 4.10 axles
First-year recalls: two wiper-motor campaigns (02V283000, 08V456000), the key and shifter override (03V075000) and the Hydro-boost relief valve (04V045000, also 2004)
Hydro-boost accumulator (05V043000) and second-row center seat belt routing (05V163000) recalls
The H2 SUT pickup goes on sale; the 6.0 is now rated at 325 hp and 365 lb-ft
Owners say the front diff was strengthened and build quality improved from mid-2005; one owner would choose a 2005.5–07 truck over a 2003
Avtotor begins licensed H2 assembly in Kaliningrad, Russia (to 2009). Power steering hose recall 05V455000
Heated washer fluid module recalls (08V441000, then 10V240000 after new fire reports)

Major update: 6.2 L L92 V8 (393 hp, 415 lb-ft), 6L80 six-speed, towing up to 8,000 lb, crawl ratio about 39:1, stronger transfer case, quicker steering, new interior with a rotary 4WD dial, curtain airbags and panic brake assist. Owners call the 2008–09 trucks the most refined H2s
Last year. Production ends as GM tries to sell Hummer; the planned Black Chrome Limited Edition stops at six trucks, according to Wikipedia

identify.intro: Every H2 is a GM-engineered, AM General-built truck, but 2008–09 trucks have a different engine, transmission, interior and some chassis parts. Many trucks have also been lifted, converted from air springs to coils or re-engined, so check what you're looking at.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US H2 VINs begin 5GR (for example 5GRGN23U73H135443, a 2003 sold on Bring a Trailer). The owner's manual says the 8th character is the engine code: U is the 6.0 VORTEC 6000 (2004 manual) and 8 is the 6.2 (2008 manual). The 10th character is the model year.

items.head: 2003–07 vs 2008–09
items.body: 2008–09 trucks have larger grille openings, a bigger lower grille and silver-painted lower bumpers (earlier trucks' are black). Inside, the dash and gauges are new and a rotary dial replaces the 4WD push buttons.

items.head: SUT
items.body: The pickup has a short bed, a power Midgate window and a folding Midgate, an outside swing-away spare, and extra taillights in the lower rear bumper.

items.head: Options label
items.body: The Service Parts Identification label in the glovebox lists the VIN, paint and every production option. Look for ZM6, the GM option code for the self-leveling rear air suspension.

items.head: Parts that changed in 2008
items.body: Front hub bearings differ between 2003–07 and 2008–09 trucks (Kryptonite lists separate parts). Owners say the transfer case input spline also changed, because the 6L80's output shaft differs from the four-speed's.

capability.note: GM figures; GM's 2008 release gives the outgoing truck's rating as 6,500 lb

capability.v: 10.0 in (254 mm) coil · 10.5 in (267 mm) air
capability.note: 9.9 in under the differentials; 2003 GM spec
41.7° / 38.1° / 26.6° with air suspension (GM). Car and Driver quoted 43.6° approach on the off-road package's LT315s
Exempt because GVWR is over 8,500 lb. Tested: 9–10.8 mpg (Car and Driver, Motor Trend, Edmunds, Four Wheeler)

values.intro: H2s are still affordable, but clean, unmodified, low-mile trucks, especially 2008–09s, now bring real money. Owners say untouched late trucks are getting hard to find.
values.note: Based on 18 Bring a Trailer H2 sales, May–October 2026: from $10,500 for a 2004 to $61,500 for a 10,000-mile 2008. Supercharged trucks brought $26k–43k. Several others, including a 2008 bid to $31,000, didn't meet reserve.
